review_description: They were so quick, no hassles, arrived on time, did'nt waste time, very professional.Told me what they were doing extremely happy!

As I live in Hobart & the solar company is situated in Devonport they were more than happy to come down to install my panels. I managed to get them another job as well to make it worthwhile but ANYONE in Tasmania who wants to make the move to Solar make it easy on yourself & just choose this company!I did do alot of research thank goodness I chose right.

I obtained 3 quotes, 2 from local suppliers and 1 from Energy Matters via the internet  who were the cheapest. However their terms and conditions are draconian, to say the least. Have a look for yourself. I choose the local supplier who met the criteria, set out in your (Solar Quotes) advice and the Clean Energy Council's consumer guide.
